content: The performance of the systems remains modest, of course, but we must not forget that this is a baseline and its primary objective is to provide standard systems that can be used in testing protocols such as the one we proposed. Despite this evolution, these baselines (or their improved versions) can be used in applications such as automatic document summarisation (e.g., BIBREF12, BIBREF13), or sentences compression BIBREF14.
